source_reasoning.candidate_design: Flatten the tree into Euler subtree intervals. Maintain a sorted union of allowed intervals per advertiser; revoke subtracts a range, creating exceptions.
source_reasoning.complexity_target: O(regions) preprocessing; O(intervals) updates; O(log intervals) query
source_reasoning.reference: Rescan ancestor chains and explicitly union/subtract permitted node sets.
source_reasoning.limits: Only bounded author-development cases are executed; full official domain/resource suitability is unknown

numeric_semantics: Python arbitrary-precision integers; JavaScript BigInt for grid counts, prime products, rational ratings and order quantities. Other input numeric fields are safe integers.
unicode_semantics: Passwords use Unicode code points; board and remaining identifier/string domains follow the explicit ASCII/lowercase contracts.

assumptions.basis: Public group preview only; no exact variant body

assumptions.text: A parent map describes a fixed rooted tree. Each advertiser begins with no permitted nodes. grant unions an entire subtree; revoke subtracts the entire subtree even after an ancestor grant; canAccess checks membership. A later grant can restore a revoked descendant.
